results.title: Teodoro warns PMA of ‘weaponization of information’ as warfare moves beyond battlefield
results.content: The Philippine defense chief says technological advances, geopolitical developments, disruptions to supply chains, and other changes can emerge quickly and carry consequences for the security of states and individuals

results.title: Before the Philippines even had a name, it had gold
results.content: “When you look at this gold jewelry, you realize that once upon a time we had a golden age. It gives you a sense of what was pre-colonial culture,” historian Ambeth Ocampo tells Rappler
